properties.sequence_note: High-level sequence steps keep only index, type, and entity. Vectorworks-ready centered coordinates are stored in entities.
properties.selection_policy: For slab, activate the slab tool, switch to Inner Boundary mode at screen point [292, 100], then click slab_generate_point. For roof, use Ctrl+A in the current modeling context.
properties.exterior_wall_continuity_policy: Exterior walls are ordered as a closed path by endpoint connectivity; small source gaps are snapped in the output path.
properties.gui_action_note: GUI version adds gui_action_sequence under each high-level step. Layer switching and type selection are omitted.
